text: Centre foreground: two white plastic wash bottles stand upright on square white holder plates mounted to a grey aluminium-framed bench/rail. Each has a red angled spout cap fitted; one bottle bears a green band, the other a blue band. Their contents are not clearly visible through the opaque walls. To the right of them, two empty white circular holder rings/cups sit on the platform, and a blue-topped tray edge appears at lower right.
